intro: Designed for modern professionals, the T-20 executive table seamlessly blends style and functionality, offering a clutter-free, inspiring workspace where ideas flow effortlessly.

features.title: A perfect fit for every workspace
features.text: Available in widths from 1200mm to 1800mm, the T-20 adapts to different leadership styles—whether you need a compact desk or a spacious executive workstation.

features.title: Stay organised, stay focused
features.text: Say goodbye to tangled wires. The smart cable management system, with an 8M module switch plate and soft-closing access flap, keeps your desk neat and distraction-free.

features.title: Storage that works as hard as you do
features.text: The optional all-wood pedestal blends seamlessly into the design, offering ample space for files and essentials—because a clutter-free desk means a clutter-free mind.

features.title: Designed to complement any office
features.text: Choose from sophisticated woodgrain finishes and elegant neutral tones, ensuring your workspace reflects your personality while maintaining a sleek, professional look.

features.title: Sustainable, stylish, and built to last
features.text: Crafted with eco-conscious materials, the T-20 is a responsible choice for forward-thinking offices—where great design meets environmental responsibility.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Unitized T20 Office Desk
